title: Navimower 0.4.7-beta1

## Schedule zone-handoff confirmation

This beta fixes a field-confirmed Custom queue handoff race on H215.

When one scheduler-owned zone completed and the next zone was dispatched immediately, the mower could keep reporting the previous zone in fresh MQTT `work_target_zone` / `mow_boundary` evidence for a short transition period. 0.4.6 treated that single conflicting sample as a definitive wrong-zone start and suspended the whole Schedule window with `mow_start_zone_mismatch`.

0.4.7-beta1 keeps the fail-closed protection for genuine wrong-zone retained-task starts, but distinguishes a direct scheduler zone handoff:

- a fresh previous-zone MQTT value during a direct handoff keeps the pending start unresolved instead of suspending immediately;
- fresh matching evidence for the requested zone confirms the start even if an older boundary/work-target value still disagrees;
- starts from Docked/Paused state still reject a fresh strong wrong-zone MQTT mismatch;
- if the requested zone never becomes confirmed, the existing bounded unconfirmed-start timeout still suspends safely instead of consuming the queue slot.

This matches the observed field sequence where zone 36 completed, zone 37 was requested, MQTT briefly still reported zone 36, and zone 37 became active roughly 40 seconds later.

## Prerelease raw-data export

The explicit maintainer-only `navimower.export_raw_data` action is available again on this prerelease line for controlled field investigations.

- The action writes an unredacted local JSON capture under `/config/navimower_diagnostics/raw/`.
- It includes fresh read-only private-cloud responses, full map detail, cached raw/private state, decoded map geometry, parsed current MQTT location data and local-frame diagnostics.
- Home Assistant **Download diagnostics** remains the sanitized public-support path.
- Arbitrary endpoint probing, passive discovery and exact MQTT-payload retention remain retired.
- Raw exports can contain exact map/location values and identifiers and must not be posted to public issues or forums.
- The raw export action is a beta/development surface and must be removed again before stable promotion.

## Release publishing

Navimower releases now follow the same version-driven publishing model used by Navimower Map Card.

Changing `custom_components/navimower/manifest.json` on `main` is the release trigger. The workflow validates matching release notes, derives prerelease/stable mode from the version string, creates the tag and publishes the GitHub release automatically.

Opening a special publish issue is no longer required.
